reviews.review:
Makes my computer hang, every time it updates. This has been going on since day one. I own a lot of VR games and out off all of them, only this game and Bean Stalker, act this way, taking hours to install, after downloading only a tiny update. It's like the game doesn't know how to unpack itself, as if it forgets what it's doing. This inconvenience has no excuse and should not be tolerated. I have mentioned this problem to the devs before and they did want to help but ultimately, didn't. I assure you, it's not a me issue. I always dread updating this game, because I know it's going to force me to restart my machine with a hard shutdown. Well, because steam just won't close, when this thing is updating. 

Tonight, I finally stopped this problem at the source.
I uninstalled the damn thing, after 3 attempts. Never have I uninstalled a game, had my PC freeze after the confirmation and then get forced to hard shutdown, just to reboot to see the same damn game, still trying to download, after it was uninstalled. Then I hit pause. Somehow, it worked this time, and then poof the game just disappears. Should have been simpler.

And that's why this game no longer has a home on my PC. 

And likely, never will.
